_about: Public-domain Thomas Charles of Bala (1755-1814), Welsh Calvinistic Methodist leader and a founder of the British and Foreign Bible Society, for the Word Hoard: his English works, Two Letters giving an account of a revival of religion in Wales (1792) and An Evangelical Catechism (1797), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 50 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

tcharles-two-letters: Two letters, giving an account of a revival of religion in Wales.  1792 (catalogued 1792)
tcharles-evangelical-catechism: An evangelical catechism. By the Rev. T. Charles, ... Recommended by the executors of the late Countess of Huntingdon for all the children in their schools attendant on her chapels.  1797 (catalogued 1797)

_excluded.tcharles-other: Welsh-language works (Trysorfa Ysprydol 1799, the Geiriadur) left for Adam's ruling on Welsh; the 1816 Welsh life by Jones (another author)
